description: This file contains prototypes, macros, and data structures for memory management functions used in the qhull library, including error handling, memory allocation, and internal memory structures.

methods.name: qh_memalloc
methods.description: Allocates memory of a specified size, possibly using internal quick-fit memory management.

methods.name: qh_memcheck
methods.description: Checks the integrity of the memory management system.

methods.name: qh_meminitbuffers
methods.description: Initializes memory buffers with specified parameters.

methods.name: qh_memsetup
methods.description: Sets up internal memory management structures.

methods.name: qh_memsize
methods.description: Adjusts the size of internal memory buffers.
